description:
Eight unique characters face off
in an exciting card-flipping showdown!

Flipi Rivals!

Follow the story through the eyes of Panda
in Story Mode.

Discover the stories of all eight characters
and take on a series of battles in Arcade Mode.

Challenge a friend right beside you
in Local Battle Mode.

Enjoy the game's beautiful music anytime
in the Music Room.

Plus, discover a variety of game-changing items
and unique battle arenas!

Simple controls, intense competition!
Test your reflexes and memory!

Use quick thinking and strategy
to become the ultimate Card Master!

An exciting card battle with adorable rivals!

Flipi Rivals!

Flip the cards. Turn the tide!
